async def InteractiveAgent.handle(self, notification: dict[str, list]) -> Done | NeedInput | NeedInputForm | Waiting:
    """Handle one interactive turn."""

## Referenced Types
class Done(BaseModel):
    """Turn result: the work for this turn is finished."""

    explanation: str  # Status line saying what was finished; not the reply
    message: str | None = None  # The reply to show the user
    evidence: list[str]  # Short checkable facts, e.g. "pytest tests/x.py: 24 passed"
    result: Any | None = None  # TaskResult when a delegated or bench task completes

class NeedInput(BaseModel):
    """Conversational question, answered by the next user message; never a dialog."""

    kind: Literal[question] = 'question'
    question: str
    reason: str | None = None

class NeedInputForm(BaseModel):
    """Ordered native questions. Ask doc(TextQuestion), etc. for control details."""

    kind: Literal[form] = 'form'
    heading: str  # [min_len=1]
    reason: str | None = None
    questions: list[TextQuestion | IntegerQuestion | NumberQuestion | BooleanQuestion | ChoiceQuestion | MultiChoiceQuestion]  # Authored order; unique ids; ask doc(Type) for each control [min_len=1, max_len=64]

    def validate_response(self, response: FormResponse) -> FormResponse:
        """Check ids, required presence and native constraints; no coercion/default insertion."""

class Waiting(BaseModel):
    """Turn result: waiting on a background job or queue, not on a person."""

    explanation: str  # Why the turn is waiting
    message: str | None = None  # Line to show the user while waiting
    on: list[str]  # Names of the channels, jobs or subagents being waited on [min_len=1]
